semantic.justification: Extracts the existing original currency value unchanged and restores zero-character storage and original positive/negative format entry points. Actual locale/currency fields and original code owners remain in use. B8TCAE restores the original public NfCurrencyEntry::GetEffectivePositiveFormat and GetEffectiveNegativeFormat scalar contracts declared in include/svl/zforlist.hxx. The existing pattern builder delegates to those same source responsibilities with original NF_BANKSYMBOL_FIX_POSITION=1 and UInt16 argument conversion. No immutable currency field or locale provider is replaced. An independent witness compiles unchanged original member bodies, original private parenthesis helper and original public declarations; only SAL_WARN logging is silenced.1936 native output rows span all defined placements, bank modes, diagnostic values and unsigned16 conversion boundaries. This establishes scalar placement results, not full native currency/formatter ABI, allocation or concurrency equivalence. Prior currency-owner counter maps are stale after this restoration and require recollection.
